matchups.preview: Rilind's about to learn the hard way that autodrafting while hungover doesn't build championship teams, and Rob's out here with a roster that screams "I panicked and reached for a kicker in round 6." Both of you are walking into Week 1 with the confidence of guys who absolutely will not have it by Sunday night.

Jetmir and Peter are about to learn what it means to play with an actual coherent roster strategy, because whatever handshake deal you two made in the draft room is about to get exposed by someone who knows how to build a fucking team. Adam's coming in cold and hungry while you're both still trying to figure out if your waiver wire desperation picks actually have a pulse—spoiler alert, they don't.

Ilir's about to get a crash course in why his "wait on QB" strategy is going to leave him streaming backups by week 4, while Rinor stumbles out of the gate with whatever reaches he panicked into on day 2 -- this matchup is basically a race to see who can fuck up their season the fastest.

Faton's about to learn that drafting three tight ends in the first four rounds doesn't make you a genius—it makes you a cautionary tale. Flamur's out here with a roster that looks like he rage-quit the draft halfway through, but honestly? That might accidentally work better than whatever the fuck Faton was thinking. This Week 1 matchup is gonna be a absolute shitshow, and we're all just here to watch two franchises simultaneously discover what they've built.

Veton's rolling out what looks like a team built by throwing darts blindfolded at a board, while Arben probably just autopicked his entire roster and called it a strategy—either way, someone's about to learn that week one doesn't give a shit about your preseason hype. This matchup is gonna be a beautiful disaster of two teams with absolutely no fucking clue what they're doing, and we're all here for it.

Ben's out here thinking he cracked the code with whatever mid-round horseshit he grabbed on draft day, but we both know he's about to get humbled by reality. Nori's got the look of someone who actually studied film for once, and even a broken clock is right twice a day—this week, that clock is about to go off right in Ben's face. Time to see which one of you dipshits drafted like you were playing drunk, because something tells me we're about to find out real fucking quick.
